value.rationale: Answers a natural finite-field arithmetic incidence question for the 48 distinguished curves on a smooth quartic K3 surface, with a sharp unique full-coverage finite field and a complete incidence spectrum over the whole split-line congruence class, not a one-off numerical check. Geometry and known F25 case are explicitly separated from new global cutoff and structural classification. Reusable boundary for counting points outside low-degree curves on K3 surfaces.
